positions.title: Lead Tutor/TA
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Lead tutor/TA for ECE 5: Making, Breaking, and Hacking Stuff. 
Course is designed to give freshmen students confidence, motivation, and insight into what is to come in the rest of their undergraduate careers through a series of hands-on projects.
Built a basic programming workshop for beginning ECE students, including designing the slides, lecturing in front of a 60 student section, and creating and grading a supplemental homework assignment to reinforce the student's knowledge on programming.
Volunteered to take on all of the grading for a 180 student class, as well as migrating grading software from Blackboard to GradeScope.
Currently reworking the code for a line following robot that uses photo resistors and PID control to follow a line.

positions.title: Summer Internship
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
The startup company Goju Labs created Lessonaire.com, which is an online web application for tutors and coaches to expand their businesses online.
Developed an RSS feed for tutor's blogs that allowed subscribers to be notified every time a tutor posted an article.
Expanded the search function for tutors by adding a zipcode parameter so users can search for tutors based on zipcode.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Assisted another intern by writing code in C++ to collect data from EEGs
Recorded signals from the throat area to spot the difference between spoken and non spoken sounds

volunteerExperiences.description:
Once or twice monthly I join Harvest Corps to pick fruit from residents with their permission by appointment. Their excess fruit goes to different food distribution centers to help the needy.
I personally estimate that I have picked a few tons of fruit over the years to donate to food distribution centers.
Everyone benefits from this work. The homeowner receives free labor to pick their excess fruit that would have fallen and rotted as well as a tax deduction based on the amount of fruit donated.
The volunteers get to reduce the amount of food that go to waste.
And finally the Food Pantries receive free fresh harvested fruit to distribute to those in need.
